question: My boss wants a spreadsheet of all our customers by end of day. Is there a way to get them out into Excel?

articles.title: Export contacts to a CSV file
articles.body:
1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Optionally search or filter the list. The export includes only the contacts currently shown.
3. Select **Export CSV**.

The file includes each contact's name, email, phone, job title, company, status and custom fields. It opens in Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets.

answer:
Yes, you can export your contacts to a CSV file:

1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Optionally search or filter the list. The export includes only the contacts currently shown, so leave it unfiltered to get everyone.
3. Select **Export CSV**.

The file includes each contact's name, email, phone, job title, company, status and custom fields. It opens in Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets.
